    o.o_orderpriority as priority,
    COUNT(*) as order_count,
    AVG(o.o_totalprice) as avg_order_value,

- **Supplier counts**: Range from 362 (Jordan) to 438 (Iraq)
- **Average supply costs**: Tightly clustered around $493-$512 across all nations/categories

### Conclusion
